summary: This bill repeals federal motor vehicle emission and fuel standards under the Clean Air Act and federal automobile fuel economy standards, nullifies related regulations and state-level standards, and prohibits the federal government and states from establishing or enforcing such standards in the future.

scores.thoughts: This bill explicitly repeals sections of the Clean Air Act related to motor vehicle emission and fuel standards, as well as federal and state automobile fuel economy standards. It also prohibits the establishment of future fuel emission standards, which would lead to less environmental protection by removing regulations designed to limit pollutants.
